key_findings: Daegu District Court 2010Gahap2484 provides a reusable judicial fact chain from 1961 arrest through retrial and state liability.
The later court found the anonymized plaintiff's warrantless arrest unlawful, 161-day pre-indictment detention unlawful, and July 1961 dismissal without ordinary disciplinary procedure unlawful.

The 2010 retrial acquittal treated the plaintiff's anti-two-evil-laws activity as protected expression rather than proven anti-state encouragement; acquittal became final at Supreme Court 2010Do8530 on 2010-11-11.
The special criminal statute used in the revolutionary trial was enacted after arrest and contained a 3-year-6-month retroactivity clause.

A new identity-binding conflict exists: secondary officer rosters name Kim Hui-jo as 1960-07-17 secretary-general, while the anonymized judicial plaintiff is also described as elected secretary-general that date and as a Kyungpook National University affiliated high-school teacher. Do not silently merge.
National Archives catalogs identify concrete record groups for 1961 teacher-union dismissal lists, teacher appointment registers, judgments/personnel documents and litigation tracking.

A 2023 TRC finding independently confirms a Gyeongnam teachers-union vice-chair suffered post-coup unlawful detention and forced dismissal, supporting a victim-by-victim graph rather than one representative case.
